title: How does ABA therapy at Pinnacle Blooms help children with Autism manage likes and dislikes about food?
metaTitle: ABA therapy for Food Management in Autism at Pinnacle Blooms
description: Read about how Pinnacle Blooms Network utilises ABA Therapy to help children with Autism manage their food preferences.
html: Managing food preferences can indeed be challenging for children with Autism. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we use ABA Therapy to assist with this sensitively. The approach introduces new foods to your child about step by step, while positively reinforcing each attempt with rewards. Strategies like mimicking eating habits and consistent exposure are applied to make your child comfortable with varied diets.
